verdict.rationale: The getting-started docs state that LocalAI ships a built-in web interface for chatting with models, with no extra tools needed. They also describe chat-UI interactions such as hovering over a saved message to edit it, plus a Discover page for installing models. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the web chat UI, and deeper documentation of chat features such as conversation history and in-UI model switching.
